w:r.w:t: DM-R1 | Referential Integrity — No Orphan Satellite Rows (OPUS)
Every satellite row references a valid hub (or link) key. Pass criterion: 0 orphan satellite rows.
Anti-join: satellite key -> parent hub / link (the table whose src_pk is the satellite's src_pk)
Parents (hubs / links) are checked across ALL their rows: a key may have been loaded by the other project. Child rows (satellites / links) are scoped to this project's RECORD_SOURCE.
Satellite rows keyed by the ghost hash TO_BINARY(REPEAT('0', 32), 'HEX') are excluded from the orphan test.
